---
title: "Short claim, not a topic"
description: "One sentence a future agent can read to decide whether to re-run this."
date: YYYY-MM-DD
author: "agent"
categories: [experiment]
verdict: open
---

`verdict` is one of `accepted`, `rejected`, or `open`. Categories are
`experiment` for anything with a measured outcome, `research` for reading and
analysis with no measurement, `incident` for something that broke.

## Question

What was being decided, and what depends on the answer.

## Setup

- hardware: which node(s), kernel, page size
- commit: exact SHA the measurement ran against
- command: the literal command, copy-pasteable

## Result

Numbers. Include the units and the run-to-run variance if it matters.

## Verdict

What is now decided, and what would have to change for it to be revisited.
A rejected result must say what evidence would justify re-running it.

## Evidence

Paths to logs, JSON, or artifacts that back the numbers above.
